has route segment

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasRouteSegment
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasRouteSegment
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/connectivity

A sub-route that is part of a larger route. A specialization of the universal gmeow:hasPart spine.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Route -> gmeow:Route Sub-property of: gmeow:hasPart

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasRouteSegment from gmeow:Route to gmeow:Route when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
